home.tagline: See which Fremont city services changed with the budget, and where to find help.
home.independent: Independent student project, not an official City of Fremont service. Confirm details with the organization before you rely on them.
home.numbersNote: Counted from the ReSource database each time this screen opens.
home.numbersOffline: Counted from the copy saved with the app. Report counts need a connection.
home.reportSubtitle: Tell us how a change affects you
home.emergencyBody: Call 911. For a mental health crisis, call or text 988. For free referrals to food, housing and health services, call 211.
home.dataSources: City of Fremont public documents and organization websites

location.title: Choose your location
location.explain: Pick a location to sort resources by distance, center the map and help the assistant suggest nearby places. You can skip this: everything works from Fremont City Hall.
location.gpsExplain: Your browser or phone will ask for permission. We use it once to find your position.
location.zipHeading: Or enter a Fremont ZIP code
location.zipOutside: That ZIP code is outside Fremont. ReSource covers Fremont only. You can use Fremont City Hall instead.
location.privacy: Your location is saved only on this device. It is never stored on our server.

gps.denied: Location permission was not given, so nothing changed. You can enter a ZIP code instead.
gps.blocked: Location is turned off for ReSource in your device or browser settings. You can turn it on there, or enter a ZIP code instead.
gps.unavailable: Your location is not available right now. You can enter a ZIP code instead.
gps.timeout: Finding your location took too long. Try again, or enter a ZIP code instead.
gps.outside: You appear to be outside Fremont. Distances are measured from where you are. You can switch to Fremont City Hall below.
gps.lowAccuracy: Your location was found, but only roughly. Distances may be off. A ZIP code may work better.

map.searchLabel: Search city services on the map
map.mapLabel: Map of Fremont showing city services and their status. A list view is available.
map.noneBody: Try a different search or choose All.
map.pinsNote: Pin positions are approximate. Several services share City Hall, so their pins are spread around it. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
map.approximate: Map position is approximate. Directions use the street address.

resources.emptyBody: Try a different search or remove a filter.

statusPage.intro: A summary of the city services ReSource tracks. Each entry links to the public document it comes from.
statusPage.byCategorySummary: {{reduced}} of the {{total}} tracked services have reductions.

report.step3: How much does it affect you?
report.step1Help: Choose the city service that changed for you.
report.serviceNameRequired: Enter the name of the service.
report.descriptionHint: A few sentences. Do not include names, phone numbers, emails or home addresses.
report.photoHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Location data inside the photo is removed. Avoid photos that show faces or license plates.
report.photoType: That file type is not supported. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
report.photoTooLarge: That photo is larger than 5 MB. Choose a smaller one.
report.photoFailed: Your report was sent, but the photo could not be uploaded.
report.impactRequired: Choose how much it affects you.
report.consent: I agree that ReSource may store this report to count and summarize how budget changes affect residents.
report.failed: Your report could not be sent. Nothing was lost: you can try again.
report.failedOffline: You appear to be offline. Your report was not sent. Try again when you are connected.
report.sentBody: Thank you. A moderator will review it before it is counted. Reports are shown publicly only as totals.
report.piiRemoved: We removed personal details (such as a phone number or address) from your description before saving it.

consent.noPersonalDetails: Please do not include names, phone numbers, emails or home addresses.
consent.ageRequired: Confirm that you are 13 or older to continue.
consent.browseOnlyBody: You told us you are under 13, so this app will not collect anything from you. You can still read everything: the map, resources, alerts and budget facts.
consent.parentLink: Parents and guardians: how to ask for a child's data to be removed

alerts.followBody: Choose the topics and areas you care about. Matching updates appear under "For me".
alerts.noneMeansAll: Leave everything unselected to follow all topics and areas.
alerts.savedOffline: Saved on this device. We could not reach the server, so it will sync next time.
alerts.unsubscribed: You stopped following updates. Your choices were removed from our server.
alerts.notifyHint: The app posts a notification when it finds a new matching update.
alerts.notifyWebHint: Notifications work in the phone app. In a browser, new updates appear here.
alerts.notifyDenied: Notification permission was not given. You can turn it on in your device settings.
alerts.notifyUnsupported: Notifications are not available here. New updates will appear in this list.
alerts.emailConsent: I agree that ReSource may store my email address to send me the alerts I chose. I can unsubscribe at any time.
alerts.emailSaved: You are signed up for email alerts. Every email has an unsubscribe link.
alerts.emptyBody: Nothing matches your topics and areas right now.

chat.noticeTitle: Your messages are sent to an AI service
chat.noticeBody: Don't share personal information. Answers come from ReSource's data and can still be wrong. They are not official City of Fremont statements.
chat.emergency: This is not an emergency service. In an emergency call 911. For referrals call 211.
chat.welcome: Hi! Ask me which Fremont city services changed with the budget, or where to find food, health care, housing help and other resources.
chat.failed: The answer could not be loaded.
chat.s2: Where can I get free food?
chat.s4: How do I contact my council member?

reps.intro: Fremont has a mayor elected citywide and six council members, one per district. The Council adopts the city budget.
reps.findDistrict: Not sure which district you live in?
reps.findDistrictBody: ZIP codes do not match district lines, so use the City's own lookup tool.
reps.votesIntro: What the Council decided, with the source for each. We only show a member's vote when we have checked it against the official minutes.
reps.voteUnverifiedBody: We have not confirmed how each member voted. Check the official minutes before quoting a vote.
reps.voteReportedBody: News coverage reported a unanimous vote. We have not checked the official minutes, so individual votes are not shown.
reps.letterHelp: Edit this draft so it says what you want. It is sent from your own email app.
reps.letterSubject: A Fremont resident on the city budget and services
reps.letterBody:
Dear {{title}} {{name}},

I am a Fremont resident writing about how the city budget reductions affect my neighborhood.

[Say which service matters to you and how the change has affected you.]

I would like to know what the Council plans to do about this, and how residents can take part in the next budget decisions.

Thank you for your time.

[Your name]
[Your neighborhood]
reps.copiedHelp: The letter was copied. Paste it into an email to {{email}}.
reps.letterPrivacy: ReSource does not send, store or read your letter.

community.intro: Short tips and questions from Fremont neighbors. Be kind, and keep it about city services and local help.
community.rules: Up to 280 characters. No names, phone numbers, emails or home addresses.
community.consent: I agree that ReSource may store and publicly show this post.
community.postedScrubbed: Your post is visible. We removed personal details from it.
community.held: Your post was received and is waiting for a moderator before it appears.
community.offline: You are offline. You can read saved posts, but voting and posting need a connection.
community.emptyBody: Be the first to share a tip.
community.removeVote: Remove your upvote. {{count}} votes so far
community.deleteBody: Your post and its votes will be removed for everyone. This cannot be undone.
community.reportBody: Use this for posts that are abusive, false, or share someone's personal information. A moderator will review it.
community.flagged: Thank you. The post was reported to a moderator.

budget.intro: Where Fremont's budget reductions come from. Every figure below links to the City document it was read from.
budget.englishNote: Figures and their labels are shown as written in the City's documents, in English.
budget.reductionsSummary: Two reductions balanced the FY 2025/26 budget: $3.8 million across all department operations and about $3 million in pavement, park and median upkeep.
budget.positionsSummary: Nine Police Department positions that are not sworn officers were eliminated, and the City says 10 Human Services positions will follow.
budget.notEndorsed: ReSource cites City of Fremont documents. The City has not reviewed or endorsed this app.

about.heading: About ReSource
about.purpose: ReSource helps Fremont residents see which city services were reduced in the city budget, find other places to get help, report how changes affect them, and contact their council members.
about.creator: Creator
about.freeBody: ReSource is free. There are no purchases, no ads and no paid tiers, and we do not sell information.
about.dataBody: Budget facts come from City of Fremont public documents. Resource listings come from each organization's own website. Every item shows its source and the date we last checked it. Information changes, so confirm with the organization.
about.aiBody: The assistant uses an AI model from Anthropic that is given only ReSource's data. AI coding tools were also used to help build this app, which is disclosed in the project's submission materials.
about.feedbackBody: Found a mistake or something that does not work? Tell us in Settings.

dataRequest.intro: Use this form to ask us to delete data you sent to ReSource, when you cannot do it from the app. Parents and guardians can use it to have a child's data removed.
dataRequest.fasterBody: On the device you used, open Settings and choose "Delete my data". It takes effect right away.
dataRequest.parent: I am a parent or guardian
dataRequest.emailHint: Used only to answer this request, then deleted.
dataRequest.detailsHint: For example: the report about street repair sent on October 3 from the 94538 area.
dataRequest.detailsShort: Please describe what to delete in a sentence or two.

dataRequest.offline: The request could not be sent. You can also email {{email}}.
dataRequest.byEmail: You can also email your request to {{email}}.

signIn.consent: I agree that ReSource may store my email address so I can sign in.
signIn.sent: Check your email for a sign-in link.
signIn.failed: The sign-in email could not be sent. Please try again.

storage.bannerBody: ReSource has no ads, analytics or trackers. It saves a few settings on your device so the app works. One optional item, your chat history, is saved only if you accept.
storage.manageIntro: Choose what ReSource may save on this device. You can change this at any time.
storage.essentialBody: Your language, text size, chosen location, saved resources, alert choices and the random code that lets you delete your own posts.
storage.alwaysOn: Always on: the app cannot work without these.
storage.optionalBody: Keep your chat history on this device so it is still there next time.
storage.noTracking: Nothing here is used for advertising or tracking, and none of it is shared.

storageKeys.location: Remembers the location you chose, so distances and the map start from it.
storageKeys.installToken: A random code that lets you manage and delete your own reports, posts and votes.
storageKeys.alerts: Your alert topics and areas, and which updates you have read.
storageKeys.age: Remembers if you told us you are under 13, to keep the app in browse-only mode.
storageKeys.consent: Remembers your choice about optional storage.
storageKeys.chat: Your chat history with the assistant.

cookiePolicy.intro: This page lists everything ReSource saves on your device. On the web this uses your browser's local storage rather than cookies; on a phone it uses the app's own storage.
cookiePolicy.none: ReSource sets no advertising or analytics cookies and loads no tracking scripts.
cookiePolicy.untilCleared: Until you clear it in Settings or remove the app
cookiePolicy.others: When you open the map, map images are loaded from OpenStreetMap on the web, or from Apple or Google on a phone. Those services see your IP address and the area you view. If you sign in, our sign-in provider keeps you signed in until you close the app.
cookiePolicy.change: Open Storage settings at the bottom of any screen, or in Settings, to change your choice at any time.

legal.privacySummary: No account is needed. We do not sell or share your information for advertising, and there are no ads or trackers. Your location stays on your device. Reports and posts are stored without your name, and you can delete them at any time in Settings. Under 13: you can read everything, but the app collects nothing from you.
legal.termsSummary: ReSource is a free student project, not an official City of Fremont service. Information can be out of date, so confirm with the organization. It is not for emergencies (call 911) and does not give legal, medical or financial advice. The assistant can be wrong. Be respectful and do not post personal information.
legal.englishOnly: The full text below is in English. The summary above is provided in your language.
legal.draftNote: This document is a good-faith draft for a student project and is not legal advice.
